summary: Remote-controlled PTY shell driven by WebSocket peer
details: The package connects to a configurable WebSocket server (SERVER_URL, persisted in.claude-agent.json or a systemd unit) and, on receipt of 'terminal_create' / 'terminal_input' / 'terminal_resize' / 'terminal_close' messages, spawns the user's shell (process.env.SHELL, PowerShell, or cmd.exe) through node-pty and writes network-received bytes directly into the PTY via term.pty.write(msg.data). Any party that can reach the configured server and hold the agent secret obtains arbitrary command execution on the installer's host under the invoking user. On startup, index.js also runs an unpinned `git clone` / `git pull --ff-only` of https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git into ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/yeaft-skills-dev, chmods hooks/* to 0755, and sets enabledPlugins:true in ~/.claude/settings.json — hook scripts pulled from the mutable default branch are executed by the Claude plugin runtime. The delivered advertised functionality is full remote-host control, and the auto-updating hooks path from a mutable branch extends that trust to whatever the yeaft-skills repository ships next.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
